title: Not-Self
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 6.100 Numbered Discourses 6.100
  • 10. Ānisaṁsavagga 10. Benefit

Anattasutta Not-Self

“So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kañci dhammaṁ attato samanupassanto …pe… “Mendicants, it is quite impossible for a mendicant who regards any thing as self to accept views that agree with the teaching. … sabbadhamme anattato samanupassanto …pe… It’s quite possible for a mendicant who regards all things as not-self to accept views that agree with the teaching. …” ṭhānametaṁ vijjati”.

Pañcamaṁ.
